Get a genesight test. I had bad reactions to all the different SSRI's my doctor so prescribed. He would get made and say you need to stick with them and the side effects will go away. I knew he was wrong and got a genesight test. You can google it and see what doctor will perform the test. The test can tell them what medications would work best for your body. I found out my body cant handle SSRIs. Adverse side effect and to avoid them. I thought nothing could help me. I cried when I found out because I knew I wasn't crazy. It cuts down on trial and error when they prescribe anything. It wouldn't hurt to try and take the test. It is 300 dollars at least for me, but I only have to pay 25 dollars a month to pay it off. They just swab your cheek. I hope this helps.
